about:
I like to build things that (hopefully) don't break 🏗️. My career path wasn't exactly a straight line. I actually started out designing life-safety electrical and fire systems for massive industrial plants ⚡🧯. In that world, a "bug" means a literal disaster. Today, I build full-stack web applications and backend architectures—where a "bug" just means I spend three hours shouting at my monitor before realizing I missed a semicolon 🤬💻.

But I’ll let you in on a secret 🤫: before I was deep in enterprise software, I survived the absolute frontlines of customer service and retail operations at Zain and STC 📞. If you want to understand human psychology, don't read a textbook—try explaining a telecom bill to a furious customer 😤. That experience basically gave me an unofficial PhD in human behavior 🧠. It taught me how to read attitudes, handle absolutely anyone, and stay cool under pressure (well, most of the time 🧘‍♂️).

Personality-wise, I’m a bit of a walking contradiction 🎭. I like to describe myself as "short-long"—short patience for bad code, but a very long attention span for the things I love ⏳. I can be a little moody, occasionally loud when I'm passionate (or debugging), and my YouTube "Watch Later" playlist is a terrifying black hole of thousands of videos that I will absolutely, definitely, 100% watch... someday 📺🕳️. Probably. (No, I won't 🤷‍♂️).

When I’m not hand-coding system architectures or pretending I don't use AI to fix my typos 🤖, I run on excessive amounts of tea and pure summer vibes ☕☀️. I'm currently teaching myself how to play the piano 🎹—very basic stuff, but we’re getting there. If I'm away from the keyboard, I'm probably swimming 🏊‍♂️, cruising around in my silver Jeep Wrangler 🚙, trying to get my Home Assistant server to turn on my lights perfectly 💡, or configuring retro emulators to play the arcade games of my childhood 🕹️.

I built this space because I wanted a corner of the internet that's just mine 🌍. It’s not just a professional portfolio; it’s a place where I plan to share the real stuff—life challenges, tech struggles, weird hardware experiments, and funny facts I pick up along the way 🚀.

So grab a cup of tea 🍵, take a look around, and if you want to talk about software, hardware, or how to psychoanalyze people, drop me a line!✌️
